decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already replaces INA219 with INA3221 in the DCDC1 load description, so no additional change is required.
Selecting INA3221 does not change USB enumeration, data routing, or standalone programming behavior.
The INA3221 selection does not change the already established 5V LED supply, level shifting, data interface, or standby control.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records INA3221 as the current-monitor device, while both 3.3V and 5V were already monitored before this event.
The source accepts an INA3221 current-monitor device and does not decide the daughterboard's LED part, voltage, count, or form.
The current-monitor substitution does not alter the charge-status display or external charge-LED interface.
Measuring the 5V rail with INA3221 does not change the boost converter, its enable control, output routing, or powered loads.
The INA3221 decision is unrelated to USB-C connector selection, compatibility, or availability.
Replacing INA219 with INA3221 does not change the AXP2101 battery input or its role as the normal-operation power source.
The current-monitor selection does not change the interboard connectors, pinout, board power chain, or distribution roles.
Although INA3221 uses I2C, its selection does not necessarily change the established pull-ups, series resistors, bus speed, or cable constraints.
The INA3221 substitution does not change the selected ESP32-S3 module or part number.
